Tier.Label: {name} (INT {range})
Tier.beastHint: Animals and beasts. They don't talk: they growl, howl and act. Use *asterisks* to describe the action.
Tier.bruteHint: Ogres, orc brutes, trolls. Broken speech, short simple lines.
Tier.averageHint: Bandits, soldiers, cultists. Direct threats and common insults.
Tier.cunningHint: Captains, assassins, mages. Tactical and sarcastic, points out the target's mistakes.
Tier.geniusHint: Dragons, mind flayers, liches. Eloquent, cold and condescending.

Editor.GlobalHint: NPCs without their own quotes use the quotes for their intelligence tier. {alvo} becomes the attacked character's name.
Editor.TierInfo: Tier in use: {tier}. Empty boxes use this tier's default quotes.

hit.Label: On a solid hit
hit.Hint: One quote per line. Use {alvo} for the attacked character's name.

crit.Label: On a critical hit (optional)
crit.Hint: If empty, the hit quotes are used.

miss.Label: On a bad miss (mockery/insult)
miss.Hint: When the NPC misses by a lot, it belittles or insults the character.

Editor.Empty: No quotes set for this case.

globalEditor.Name: Default quotes
globalEditor.Label: Edit default quotes
globalEditor.Hint: Quotes per intelligence tier, used by NPCs that don't have their own.

enabled.Name: Enable battle quotes
enabled.Hint: Show a quote when an NPC hits or misses an attack by a wide margin.

minMargin.Name: Minimum margin
minMargin.Hint: The quote only appears if the attack beats the AC (or falls short of it) by MORE than this value. With 5: hit by 6+ or miss by 6+.

showMiss.Name: Mock on bad misses
showMiss.Hint: When the NPC misses by more than the minimum margin, it belittles or insults the character.

extremesAlways.Name: Natural 20 and 1 always show
extremesAlways.Hint: A crit shows a crit quote and a natural 1 shows mockery, even without reaching the margin.

audience.Name: Who sees the quote
audience.Hint: Private GM rolls (whispered or blind) are only shown to the GM.

noTarget.Name: Attack without a target
noTarget.Hint: Without a targeted token (T key) the module has no AC to compute the margin.

chance.Name: Chance to appear (%)
chance.Hint: Use less than 100 so the quote doesn't appear on every qualifying roll.

imageSource.Name: Image shown
imageSource.Hint: Which NPC image appears with the quote.

showName.Name: Show NPC name
showName.Hint: Uses the token's name on the scene (handy if you rename tokens to hide the real name).

scale.Name: Size (%)
scale.Hint: Size of the quote card. 100 is the original size; 150 is 50% bigger.

holdTime.Name: Time on screen (seconds)
holdTime.Hint: How long the quote stays after the last word. Click the quote to dismiss it early.

useGlobal.Name: Use default quotes
useGlobal.Hint: NPCs without their own quotes use the defaults for their intelligence tier. Unchecked: only NPCs with quotes speak.

includePlayerOwned.Name: Include player-owned NPCs
includePlayerOwned.Hint: Also show quotes for NPCs controlled by players (summons, companions).
